title: fusionAIze Provider Catalog v1.3
description: Provider catalog with pricing, capabilities, and freshness metadata. v1.1 (additive): adds tier_status and expires_at per-provider fields. v1.2 (additive): adds modalities, image token pricing, free_tier, and evidence metadata. v1.3 (additive): splits the single fused recommended_model string into separate vendor/model/variant/hop fields (the canonical ID path is generated from these, never parsed from a string), splits modalities into input_modalities/output_modalities, adds capacity fields with mandatory evidence, and reserves the auto/ intent namespace. Older consumers ignore unknown fields.

schema_version.description: fusionaize-provider-catalog version string, e.g. 'fusionaize-provider-catalog/v1.2'. v1, v1.1, and v1.2 are all valid; older consumers ignore unknown fields.

routing_modes.$comment: v1.3: the reserved auto/ intent namespace. These are the absichtsbasiert (intent-based) routing modes, each in canonical auto/<name> form. 'auto' is itself the default intent, hence auto/auto. A physical provider entry must never occupy this prefix.

recommended_model.$comment: v1.3 (MUSS-2, option a): recommended_model is DERIVED, never stored. In pre-v1.3 catalogs it was a stored value carrying the full upstream identity; v1.3 splits that identity into vendor/model/variant/hop, so the stored field is gone. Loaders reconstruct it as `model` for an auto-selectable provider (tier_status absent, 'active', or 'preview') and `null` for a non-auto-selectable one ('expired' or 'deprecated'). A stored recommended_model must NOT appear in the data file; the schema keeps this property only so that a legacy document carrying the field is still accepted (additionalProperties tolerates it) without the field being read as a second, driftable truth.

tier_status.description: v1.1: lifecycle state of this provider tier. Defaults to 'active' when absent.

expires_at.description: v1.1: ISO date after which this provider entry should be treated as expired (free tier ends, deprecated, etc.)

items.$comment: Divergence: provider-catalog.v1.schema.json accepts 'image_generation' in its modalities enum while model-catalog.v1.schema.json does not. Reconciling the two vocabularies is an open decision, not resolved here.

input_modalities.$comment: v1.3: what the model RECEIVES. Split from the flat 'modalities' list so a model can take image input and produce text output (e.g. the vision model). 'vision' migrated to input 'image'; 'image_generation' migrated to output 'image'.

output_modalities.$comment: v1.3: what the model PRODUCES. Split from the flat 'modalities' list. 'text' stays text on both sides; 'image_generation' becomes output 'image'.

vendor.description: v1.3: the model manufacturer. Part of the canonical ID path [hop/]vendor/model[:variant], generated from separate fields, never parsed from a string.

model.description: v1.3: the model identifier. Part of the canonical ID path. Must not repeat a segment already present via vendor or hop, and must not claim the reserved auto/ intent namespace.

variant.description: v1.3: optional variant suffix (:variant), e.g. reasoning-effort tiers or 'free'. Omitted when absent. Must not claim the reserved auto/ intent namespace.

hop.description: v1.3: ordered list of intermediaries (resellers/gateways/hosts) prefixed before vendor/model in the canonical ID path. Empty for direct providers; e.g. blackboxai/... -> hop: [blackboxai]. No intermediary may repeat (a loop is exactly what the trail exists to make visible), and no segment may claim the reserved auto/ prefix.

evidence.description: v1.3: mandatory whenever a token capacity value is present. A capacity value without evidence is rejected.

image_tokens_max.description: v1.2: maximum number of tokens one image is billed as (e.g. DeepSeek V4-Flash-Vision tokenizes an image up to 384 tokens, charged at the model's normal token price).

allOf.$comment: v1.3: vendor and model are a coupled pair. Either both are present (physical ID path) or neither (legacy/other entry). A model without a vendor would re-fuse identity into a single string.
